channel.description: Latest articles from Hoover Sun LLC (hooversun.com)

item.title: Hoover resident named Alabama French Teacher of the Year
item.description: Hoover resident Allison Harris, a French teacher at the Altamont School, was named the Alabama World Language Association’s 2026 Teacher of the Year.

item.title: Hoover Air Force JROTC program seeks to build leaders
item.description: Hoover High’s AFJROTC program builds leadership and character through competitions, service and hands-on training, producing nationally ranked drill teams and confident student leaders.

item.title: Bucs, Jags prep for regionals
item.description: Hoover and Spain Park's basketball teams are ready to hit the hardwood for the next round of the playoffs.

item.title: MicroFlex to open flexible workspace facility off Old Columbiana Road
item.description: MicroFlex will open a new 37,500-square-foot flexible workspace facility in February at 3890 Douglas Way in Hoover, offering 30 office-warehouse units.

item.title: From Hoover garage hobby to international buzz: Adam Hickman’s garage beekeeping experiment has grown into Foxhound Bee Co.
item.description: What began as a garage hobby in 2012 grew into Foxhound Bee Co., an Irondale storefront supplying beekeepers worldwide with quality gear, education and a community-centered approach to the art of beekeeping.

item.title: Hoover native Dr. Jonathon Whitehead joins Southlake Orthopaedics
item.description: Dr. Jonathon Whitehead, a Hoover High graduate and fellowship-trained orthopaedic surgeon, has joined Southlake Orthopaedics on Southlake Parkway.

item.title: Bucs, Jags preview soccer season at media day
item.description: Hoover and Spain Park soccer teams previewed 2026 at media day, with the Bucs chasing a deeper playoff run and the Jaguars aiming to rebound and return to championship form.

item.title: Get to Know: Birmingham Boys Choir Executive Director Jeff Caulk
item.description: The privilege of partnering with families and watching young men rise to their potential is deeply rewarding."

item.title: Senlek Thai Rice & Noodles recently opened in Riverchase
item.description: Senlek Thai Rice & Noodles recently opened in The Plaza at Riverchase, serving Thai street food, seafood and noodle soups.

item.title: LCS earns top ranking in senior living resident satisfaction for seventh year
item.description: LCS, manager of Galleria Woods in Hoover, was ranked No. 1 in independent senior living resident satisfaction in J.D. Power’s 2025 study.
